Build a preconditioner

Source: R/preconditioner.R
preconditioner.Rd

Build a preconditioner

Usage

preconditioner(
  apply_inverse,
  fixed = TRUE,
  hermitian = NA,
  positive_definite = NA,
  side = "left",
  dim = NULL,
  apply_inverse_adjoint = NULL
)

Arguments

apply_inverse

`function(R)` returning `z = M^-1 r`, always this direction.

fixed

Is the map fixed across calls? A flexible preconditioner is rejected by solvers that require a fixed one.

hermitian, positive_definite

Declared properties, three-valued.

side

`"left"`, `"right"` or `"split"`.

dim

`c(n, n)`.

apply_inverse_adjoint

`function(R)` returning `M^-H r`. Needed only by a method that runs on `A M^-1` and has to apply its adjoint, which in v0.1 is LSQR and LSMR. A hermitian `M` supplies it for nothing, since `M^-H = M^-1` there, so this is for the case where the two differ.

Value

An object of class `preconditioner`.
